page_title: MAI 3-4 BAY | Mainz v Bayern Munich 25/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Mainz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+7' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' The Mainz players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
85' A substitution has been made. Paul Nebel is replaced by William Boving (Mainz).
85' Urs Fischer decides to make a substitution. Dominik Kohr will be replaced by Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
83' 3 - 4 Clinical finish! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds himself some space inside the box to control a rebound and fires the ball into the right side of the goal, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
80' 3 - 3 Goal! 3:4. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
80' Silvan Widmer will be replaced by Anthony Caci (Mainz).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lennard Maloney (Mainz) is coming onto the pitch as Nadiem Amiri cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' None of the Bayern Munich players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
77' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) replaces Bara Ndiaye.
75' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

73' 3 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top left corner. Daniel Batz just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:2.
71' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sheraldo Becker.
68' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
67' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

66' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
65' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
63' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Daniel Batz, who smothers the ball.
62' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

58' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
57' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Raphael Guerreiro is replaced by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich).
57' Here comes a substitution. Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Alphonso Davies.

53' 3 - 1 Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) meets a perfect cross from Konrad Laimer deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner via the post. It's 3:1.

52' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) misses a big chance after the ball is crossed into the penalty box, with his shot going well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
50' Bara Ndiaye (Bayern Munich) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
50' The game is interrupted now, Bara Ndiaye (Bayern Munich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
48' Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
46' Half-time substitution. Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) will not participate anymore and Michael Olise is coming on.
46' Vincent Kompany makes a switch. Harry Kane is coming on in place of Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Martin Petersen has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 3 - 0 Goal! Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
45+2' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the crossbar! A few inches lower and it could have been a sweet goal!
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

43' Paul Nebel (Mainz) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
42' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post.
40' Bara Ndiaye (Bayern Munich) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
39' A raking crossfield pass from Bara Ndiaye (Bayern Munich) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
38' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
34' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
32' Mainz are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
29' 2 - 0 Goal! Paul Nebel (Mainz) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
28' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
26' Referee Martin Petersen makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
24' One of the Mainz players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
24' A cross from a corner kick by Bayern Munich is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
23' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
23' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
20' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.
20' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Sheraldo Becker (Mainz), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post.
18' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jonas Urbig intercepts the ball.
15' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Kaishu Sano tees up Dominik Kohr (Mainz) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top left corner and past Jonas Urbig.
14' Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Danny da Costa (Mainz) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
13' Bayern Munich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
8' Danny da Costa (Mainz) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
7' Bayern Munich keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
6' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
4' A cross into the box picks out Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.

2' Bayern Munich slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
It should have been a goal! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
Mainz will kick-off.
Martin Petersen will officiate today.
